Surrounding rows are similarly narrative-heavy and an Appendix transition follows, so it is structurally a row but heavy on narrative.

Row contains a long case-law citation block ("see RID Novaya Gazeta and ZAO Novaya Gazeta v. Russia, no. 44561/11, §§ 111-12, 11 May 2021") inside the legal-grounds column before the canonical award/appno/CAPS-name tail. The "see X v. Y" citation is the kind of token the anti-prose filter normally rejects; this row passed because the cite is parenthesized. Reasonable either way.
